seo.description: With car tint prices starting from $295, or from $2 a day with Afterpay, be sure to contact your local Tint a Car for a quote. Learn more about our quality tints.

html:
In this article, we provide you with information to help you find out how much does car tint cost.

Tint a Car has been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. We are Australia’s most trusted office tinting specialist and are members of the Window Film Association of Australia. Our car films are independently government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality and we offer national lifetime warranties at all stores, Australia-wide.

Read on to find out how to get a quote for high quality tinting that offers excellent value for money.

Car Tint From Just $295

If you would like to know how much does auto tint cost, we have a team of tinting specialists available either over the phone or at your local Tint a Car store who can provide a quote for you.

Typically, we offer tints starting from $295 but talk to your local store for more information on this offer.

How much auto window tinting costs will be determined by the film you choose and your vehicle. We offer a range of high quality films, exclusive to Tint a Car to suit a range of budgets but also offer the following:

  • National Lifetime Warranty on most of our films
  • Interest free financing with Afterpay
  • A 30 day money back guarantee, no questions asked
  • Free courtesy cars* whilst we tint your vehicle (where available)
  • Installation by professionally trained Installers

Get a Quote Today

Call 13 TINT to speak with one of our experienced team members or use our store finder to find your nearest store to find out how much does auto tint cost for your car.
